ios.desc:
Advice that lives where your money does.

When it comes to building wealth, you don’t have to go at it alone.

Meet M1 Advisor, a registered fiduciary AI financial advisor built directly into the accounts it advises on. It sees your actual balances, remembers your goals, and tailors advice to you.

A robo-advisor allocates a portfolio. A human advisor may give you a meeting once a year. M1 Advisor conducts portfolio reviews on-demand. Make investing decisions, research stocks, analyze performance, and plan for your future with a wealth-management partner that acts in your best interest by law.

Fiduciary advice, automation, wealth management tools 

•	As a registered fiduciary, M1 Advisor is legally required to act in your best interest
•	Advice is personalized to you: your portfolio, 401(k), mortgage, outside accounts
•	Get answers a robo-advisor can't give you: Pay down the mortgage or max the IRA
•	Invest, save, and borrow in one place
•	Build custom Pies of stocks and ETFs; automated investing keeps them on target
•	Retirement made simple: Traditional IRA, Roth IRA, SEP IRA, and rollovers
•	High-yield cash accounts to keep uninvested dollars earning
•	Borrow against your portfolio with built-in margin 
•	Benchmark performance with interactive charting 
•	Identify hidden concentration risks in your portfolio

M1 Finance | Lead iOS Engineer | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | ONSITE

M1 Finance is a digital-first investment brokerage that lets you a automate trades into a custom portfolio of stocks using fractional shares and with no fees. Learn more about us at https://m1finance.com.

We’re seeking a senior iOS engineer to join us full-time in Chicago to lead the development and evolution of our iOS app from end-to-end. The app is currently live (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1071915644) and already enjoys great reviews — but we have ambitious plans, and it’s a great time to join us and make a big impact.

More detail here: https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/M1Finance/743999672703995-lead-ios-engineer. If you’re interested in our mission and want to work on a great product with great people, please apply via the link!
